name: PartnerServiceAdd React rewrite: Marketing tab
description:
## Why?

Smallest tab of the page: six flat text fields, one save path, no per-language repetition and no conditional rendering. Lowest-risk tab to port.

## What?

Port `sub/ServiceDetail/Marketing.tpl` to React, remove the external-tab bridge entry and delete the legacy partial.

Fields: `marketingCodes[googleAds]`, `marketingCodes[sklik]`, `marketingCodes[facebookPixel]`, `marketingCodes[googleAdsConversion]`, `marketingCodes[sklikConversion]`, `marketingCodes[facebookPixelConversion]`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- All six fields render with legacy labels, grouping and help texts
- Values save through `saveMarketingCodes()` with the field names unchanged
- Every `data-testid` from `Marketing.tpl` preserved verbatim, no hardcoded strings
- `Marketing.tpl` deleted and its bridge entry removed
- `make check-fast`, `make lint`, `make fe-test` green

## Resources

- Legacy: `admin/controllers/templates/sub/ServiceDetail/Marketing.tpl:7,13,19,33,39,45`
- Backend: `admin/controllers/PartnerServiceAddController.php:1026` (`saveMarketingCodes()`)
- Data: `st_crm.services_marketing_codes`
